role: Junior Consultant (all genders) AI & MLOps Engineering
notes: Found by job-scout; Munich; junior band, check salary vs Blue Card threshold; gaps MLflow/model registry/drift monitoring; German B1
apply_hint: Apply via the valantic careers site or the LinkedIn posting (https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4463494114). ATS 69%: remaining gaps are real (MLOps tooling: experiment tracking, model registry, monitoring, drift, data quality, automated testing).
verdict: You exceed the junior baseline (Master's done, 3 years of AI work, ML use cases beyond LLMs, Python, Git, CI/CD, Docker, AWS/Azure, stakeholder work at Covestro). Gaps are the classic MLOps toolchain: experiment tracking, model registry, retraining pipelines, drift monitoring (no MLflow/W&B/Databricks in the profile).

form_fields.label: Why valantic?
form_fields.value: The AI Solutions team takes AI from prototype to production across classic ML, industrial AI, GenAI and agents, with depth in MLOps and AI governance; that is the breadth and production focus I want.

form_fields.label: Salary expectation
form_fields.value: €70,000 gross/year (range €60,000–75,000); junior band may be lower, and it must be above the EU Blue Card threshold.

form_fields.label: Location
form_fields.value: Munich; happy to travel to client sites.

questions.q: How would you take a data science prototype to production?
questions.a: Package as a service (FastAPI), containerise (Docker), CI/CD with tests, infrastructure as code (you used AWS CDK), experiment tracking + model registry for versions, monitoring of data quality, performance and drift, retraining trigger. Evidence: Covestro agentic app to AWS via CDK and GitLab CI/CD.

questions.q: Tell us about an ML use case beyond LLMs.
questions.a: Covestro: RF/XGBoost/LSTM on sensor time series, lag/rolling features, benchmark vs empirical curve-fitting, Streamlit dashboard. Cognizant: EV load forecasting, LSTM 96% test accuracy.

questions.q: Why a junior consulting role with 3 years of experience?
questions.a: Breadth of projects (classic ML, industrial AI, GenAI, agents) and a team with real MLOps depth; you want production engineering skills, not just models.
